findings.description: The loop no longer removes names in param.secondary_opts from the help option names, so a secondary option name that is also in help_option_names can remain as a help option.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command has a flag option like '--flag/--no-flag' and help_option_names includes '--no-flag'. The old code removed '--no-flag' via secondary_opts; the new loop only iterates param.opts, so '--no-flag' stays in the help names. Impact: the help option collides with the user's flag, so one of them is shadowed or the help option is wrongly offered, a behavior regression from the prior code.
